newsitem.title: USA: Musicland gets waivers from senior lenders.
newsitem.headline: Musicland gets waivers from senior lenders.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Thursday its senior revolving credit lenders have agreed to extend the waivers of existing financial covenants on its revolving credit facility through June 30.
The company and a steering committee representing the lenders agreed tentatively to a new $50 million term loan and an amendment to the credit facility that would provide long-term covenant relief.
The company said the amendment requires it to reduce its revolver balance to $245 million through amortization payments totaling $30 million before the end of February 1998.
The $50 million term loan would also be secured by Musicland's inventory.

The company also said support from the trade vendors in the form of normal credit terms will be required to meet future obligations, unwind the vendor standstill agreements and achieve the company's financial plans.
